commentAccess.signup: Complete a Request to Address Board form and give it to Board staff — electronically to the Board office by noon on the day of the meeting, or in person at the meeting any time before Call to the Audience closes. The form must name the speaker and the topic, and say whether the comments relate to an agenda item.
commentAccess.timeLimit: Up to three minutes per speaker, or per written comment read aloud. The presiding officer may shorten it when many people have signed up, and speakers may not give their time to someone else.
commentAccess.writtenComment: The same form asks whether you want to speak in person or have your comments read into the record by the Governing Board Clerk. All written comments go to Board members whether or not they are read aloud.
commentAccess.commentPeriodDetail: Call to the Audience. The comment period is 45 minutes at regular meetings and 20 minutes at special meetings, and is extended only by the Board's approval. Speakers whose comments relate to an item on the agenda are taken first; the rest are taken in the order their forms arrived.
